decisions.reason: As a bread product closely aligned with the firm's established baking know-how and ingredient base, and still shown after launch, it is more likely to be adjusted through learning than discontinued.
The sweet pastry fits the firm's confectionery capabilities well, so its strong relatedness to existing knowledge makes retention and incremental refinement more likely than withdrawal.
A crusty farmhouse bread sits squarely in the firm's traditional craft domain, giving management high confidence that customer feedback can be absorbed and used to improve it rather than drop it.

The poppy seed Christmas stollen was presented as a flagship product and had a gold-awarded result, so with its excellent fit to the firm's seasonal specialty expertise it is very unlikely to be taken off the market.
The premium Christmas stollen also received a gold award and builds directly on the firm's core seasonal baking competence, making continued marketing more likely than discontinuation.
